content.text: Residents of the states listed in the ‘Your Rights’ section of our Privacy Policy: we have received your Global Privacy Control signal or you have opted out from the toggle below, but there is another step. To opt out of the “sale” or “sharing” of contact information such as your name, email address and other associated personal information or processing it for targeted ads, please submit the form below. ALL OTHER LOCATIONS: If we do not detect that you are in one of the states listed in the ‘Your Rights’ section of our Privacy Policy, we cannot ensure these choices will be honored by all third parties even if you toggle this button off. Your Privacy Choices: Opt-out of sale or sharing of personal information and opt out of targeted adsWhen you interact with us or our services, we may disclose personal information to third parties, partners, and NBCUniversal’s Related Businesses as described in our Privacy Policy. Some of this activity may be considered a "sale" or "share” under applicable law (residents of applicable states can learn more here). To opt out of such “sale” or “sharing,” follow the steps below. Opting out will also prevent the processing of your personal information for targeted ads. For direct contact information such as your name, email address and other associated personal information, please submit the form below first. For cookies and devices identifiers: switch the “Allow Sale/Share/Targeted Ads” toggle under Manage Preferences to OFF (grey color) by moving it LEFT and clicking “Confirm My Choice.” You must log in to your account first if you want your choice to apply across browsers and devices that you access through your account. This will close this box, so please open the Opt-Out Form first. Please note: Opting out will also prevent disclosure of personal information to our Related Businesses (except as necessary for the provision of services or when you permit to such disclosure). You will still see ads, but they may be less relevant or based only on our first-party information about you. Your choices related to cookies and device identifiers will apply to devices accessed with your logged in account if you opt out (or opt back in) when you are logged in. If you are not logged in, your choice will only apply to this browser, and you will need to renew this choice on each browser or device where you want your choice to apply or if you clear your browser cookies.
